description.en: Changes the uniform/kit variant used by a match member's model — team color set, uniform number, and optionally sock/other detail IDs — looked up by team slot and character ID or number.
Index of the team/side the member belongs to.
Character ID string, or a numeric character index, identifying the member to re-uniform.
Uniform/kit color set ID to apply.
0 for the home kit variant, non-zero for the away kit variant.
Optional extra uniform detail byte (defaults to 0 if omitted).
Optional shirt/uniform number (defaults to 0 if omitted).

True once the call has been processed (the uniform is only actually updated if the member is found on that team slot; otherwise this is a silent no-op); null if fewer than 4 arguments were given or the call was otherwise invalid.
